patterns.note: A full-width hero image with a large, elegant serif title overlayed, which then transitions to a compact sticky navigation upon scroll.
Prominent use of a large, decorative serif font for main section headings, contrasted with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A minimalist black and white base palette provides a clean backdrop for vibrant, intricate patterns and rich, saturated colors found in product imagery and textiles.

The initial hero image and main title parallax and scroll out of view, while the navigation bar transforms from a taller, transparent state with a centered logo to a compact, sticky white bar with a left-aligned logo.
Content sections and individual product cards are revealed with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
Product and editorial content is presented in a flexible grid layout, often with asymmetrical arrangements of images and text blocks.

technique_notes: The hero section features a large background image that scrolls at a different rate than the foreground content, creating a parallax effect. The main page title is initially large and centered, then scrolls up and out of view as the user scrolls down.

The primary navigation bar dynamically changes its appearance: initially transparent and taller with a prominent centered logo, it shrinks in height, gains a solid white background, and repositions its logo and menu items to the left once the user scrolls past the hero section, becoming sticky at the top of the viewport.

New content sections and individual elements within grids are introduced using scroll-triggered animations, likely leveraging css-keyframes to apply a subtle fade-in and upward translation effect as they become visible in the browser window.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) provide a strong visual hierarchy, complemented by a clean, readable sans-serif for body text and navigation.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are dominant across most elements, with subtle rounding on interactive components like buttons and some product images.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy spacing is used throughout, creating a sense of luxury and allowing the detailed patterns and imagery to breathe, with consistent moderate spacing in product grids.

standout: The site's distinctive use of vibrant, intricate patterns from Josef Frank, integrated into a clean, editorial layout, creates a unique blend of classic design heritage and modern web presentation. The dynamic transformation of the navigation and the subtle scroll-triggered reveals enhance the user experience without overshadowing the rich visual content.
